claims.claim: The Billing Operations landing page. The Overview tab is active by default.
Medipyxis connects to Stedi as the clearinghouse for electronic claim submission (837P), eligibility checks (270/271), claim status (276/277), and remittance advice (835).

claims.finding: Nothing sends Exported claims anywhere. Exported means the claim was exported as a PDF or JSON file: the Claims tab's Export PDF marks selected claims exported (BillingDashboard.tsx:1452-1457) and the status text reads "Claim has been exported as PDF or JSON. Claims reach Stedi only when someone submits them (Submit Claim on the claim form, which calls submit-to-stedi).

claims.claim: Status updates flow back into the Work Queue and the Payments (ERA) tab in real time, without polling.

checks.note: true only if the Work Queue or the Payments tab subscribes to changes
true only if the Work Queue does not poll

claims.finding: Stedi pushes 277CA acknowledgments and 835 ERAs to Medipyxis by webhook (sync-stedi-responses/index.ts:1-17), but the screens do not update in real time. The Work Queue polls: it reloads every 2 minutes while the tab is visible (BillingWorkQueuePage.tsx:957-964). The Payments tab has no subscription; its list is re-read on load or refresh (useERAs.ts:109-136). Only the KPI tiles above the tabs refresh on a billing_claims change (useBillingDashboard.ts:884-902).
claims.proposed_text: Stedi pushes claim acknowledgments (277CA) and remittances (835) to Medipyxis as they happen. The Work Queue picks up the change on its next refresh (every 2 minutes while the tab is visible, or click Refresh); the Payments tab shows new ERAs when it is reloaded.

proposed_checks.pattern: Webhook receiver for Stedi Event Destinations.

claims.reason: The Work Queue polls every 2 minutes; the Payments tab has no live subscription. Replaced by ovw-37.

CMS requires that claims for Medicare beneficiaries be submitted within one year of the date of service.
claims.finding: Regulatory fact; the check confirms the product encodes it (365 days for Medicare payers).

claims.claim: Claims that remain in Pending or Needs Info beyond your organization's internal filing deadline will be flagged in the AR Aging report.

checks.note: true only if the AR Aging report is not limited to submitted claims
true only if an organization filing-deadline setting exists

claims.finding: The AR Aging report counts only claims with status submitted, accepted or partial_payment (arAgingService.ts:105), so Pending and Needs Info claims never appear in it. There is no organization filing-deadline setting. Timely filing is shown per claim in the Coding Review drawer, using a fixed window by payer (timelyFiling.ts:1-9; CodingReviewDrawer.tsx:631-633).
claims.proposed_text: Pending and Needs Info claims are not in the AR Aging report, which covers submitted claims only. The Coding Review drawer shows how many days are left to file each claim, based on its payer (365 days for Medicare, 180 for Medicaid, 90 for others).
claims.reason: Pending/Needs Info claims are never in the AR Aging report and there is no org filing-deadline setting. Replaced by ovw-48.

A claim can enter the Denials workflow at any point after submission if the payer returns a denial. The claim moves to Denied (and to Appealed if you file an appeal), while the denial's own appeal status tracks separately.

checks.note: denial records carry their own appeal_status
true only if a payer denial moves the claim to Denied without a person

claims.finding: Denial records (denial_management) carry their own appeal_status, as the page says. But a payer denial does not move the claim status: no server code sets status 'denied'; an ERA denial is recorded as the ERA line's outcome (migration 20261109120000_cf226_era_posting_status_and_line_match.sql:102-106). A biller sets Denied or Appealed from the Claims tab status menu or the Work Queue Claim Status.
claims.proposed_text: When a payer denies a claim, set the claim to Denied (and to Appealed once you file an appeal). The denial's own appeal status is tracked separately on the Denials tab.
claims.reason: A payer denial does not move the claim status; a person sets Denied/Appealed. Replaced by ovw-49.
